The very sharp transition zone on FLAIR imaging is also more consistent with an IDH-wildtype glioma. While the enhancement is described as 'Mild' and the proportion of necrosis is low, these factors are outweighed by the numerous and strong indicators of an IDH-wildtype tumor.
